_note: Mod select layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are AARRGGBB hex strings (COLOR:CreateColorFromHex); opacities 0 to 1. max_w values are the widths a text is fitted into.

background_tile._note: BgTile.png repeated over the screen: columns x rows copies, step_x / step_y apart.

player_art._note: The bottom right corner of the player's picture, before the slide offset.

options._note: y is the first option row; each choice is fitted into choice_spacing_x less choice_padding.
